shortDescription: AG MELCO Elevator Co. L.L.C. supplies, installs, maintains, and modernizes Mitsubishi Electric vertical transportation systems across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: AG MELCO Elevator Co. L.L.C. delivers vertical transportation systems including Mitsubishi Electric elevators, escalators, and moving walks for commercial and residential developments. Headquartered in Dubai, it previously operated as a joint venture with Al Ghurair Investment until Mitsubishi Electric Corporation acquired full ownership in November 2025.
address: 1st Floor, Dubai Municipality Building, Salahuddin Road, Deira, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait provides retail, commercial, and wholesale banking services across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait (ABK) offers retail and corporate banking products, trade finance, treasury services, and wealth management in the UAE. It operates full-service retail branches in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, alongside a wholesale banking branch in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) regulated by the DFSA.
address: Opposite Hamarain Centre, Abu Baker Al Siddique Road, Deira, Dubai, UAE

notes: Kuwait-headquartered financial institution operating in the UAE with branches in Deira, Abu Dhabi, and DIFC; not located in Dubai Internet City.

shortDescription: Al Buhaira National Insurance Company provides comprehensive commercial, individual, and health insurance solutions across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Al Buhaira National Insurance Company (ABNIC) underwrites property, energy, medical, motor, engineering, marine, and aviation insurance. Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Sharjah, it provides risk assessment and claims management for corporate, institutional, and retail clients across branches in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and other emirates.
address: Buhaira Insurance Towers, Khalid Lagoon, Buhaira Corniche, Sharjah, UAE

notes: Headquartered on Buhaira Corniche in Sharjah with branches in Dubai (Deira and Jumeirah); not Downtown Dubai.

Al Bustan Rotana Hotel ceased operations on January 1, 2017, following the termination of the management contract between Rotana and the property owner, Dubai International Real Estate (DIRE). The property was situated in Al Garhoud (not Business Bay) and was rebranded as Mövenpick Grand Al Bustan Dubai.

shortDescription: Al Ghurair Investment is a diversified Emirati conglomerate operating across foods, resources, properties, construction, energy, mobility, and ventures.
whatTheyDo: Al Ghurair Investment operates a multi-sector portfolio including flour milling, packaging, manufacturing, real estate development, and facilities services. Headquartered in Deira, Dubai, it serves consumer and commercial markets across the Middle East, Africa, and internationally.
address: Omar Bin Al Khattab Road, Deira, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Al Mal Capital PSC is an investment advisory and asset management institution based in Dubai and regulated by the UAE Securities and Commodities Authority.
whatTheyDo: Al Mal Capital PSC delivers direct investment, asset management, corporate advisory, and capital market services to institutional and private clients. A subsidiary of Dubai Investments PJSC, it serves as the fund manager for Al Mal Capital REIT listed on the Dubai Financial Market.

shortDescription: Al Masraf is a commercial and Islamic bank offering retail, corporate, and treasury services across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Al Masraf (Arab Bank for Investment and Foreign Trade) provides consumer banking, corporate financing, Islamic banking products, and treasury operations. Established in 1975, it is owned by the UAE Federal Government (via Emirates Investment Authority), the Libyan Foreign Bank, and Banque Extérieure d'Algérie.

shortDescription: Al Safi Danone produces and distributes fresh dairy products, juices, and desserts across the GCC region.
whatTheyDo: Al Safi Danone is a joint venture between Saudi Arabia's Al Safi Group and French multinational Danone, producing fresh dairy and beverage items. In the UAE, it manages cold-chain distribution facilities supplying food retailers, supermarkets, and hospitality partners.
address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 4, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Al Serkal Group is an Emirati family-owned conglomerate operating in environmental solutions, real estate, and general trading.
whatTheyDo: Al Serkal Group manages diverse subsidiaries including Alserkal Envirol (a specialized grease trap waste recycling facility in Dubai), real estate property management, commercial agencies, and facilities management. Founded in 1947 by Nasser bin Abdullatif Alserkal, the group operates across Dubai and the Northern Emirates.
address: Office 601, 6th Floor, Alserkal Building, Airport Road, Deira, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Mohamed & Obaid Almulla Group is a Dubai-based family conglomerate with major operations in healthcare, hospitality, and real estate.
whatTheyDo: Mohamed & Obaid Almulla Group (established in 1942) owns and operates prominent healthcare and hospitality assets in Dubai, including the American Hospital Dubai, Ishraq Hospitality (managing hotel properties such as Holiday Inn and Crowne Plaza), and commercial/residential properties including Al Mulla Plaza.
address: Almulla Building, 206 Baniyas Road, Deira, Dubai, UAE

notes: In Dubai, Almulla Group primarily denotes the Mohamed & Obaid Almulla Group (founded 1942; operating American Hospital Dubai and Ishraq Hospitality; registered in Deira, not Downtown Dubai).
